raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The Qwen3.5 selector has no entry for the B300 NVFP4 agentic deployment, so its HiCache, MTP and scheduler settings are not documented. Add **Agentic aggregated + router (B300 NVFP4)** to the existing selector, backed by the five serving variants qualified in [InferenceX #2978](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2978).

The selector generates a copyable worker command (`sglang serve`) and router command (`sglang_router.launch_router`) for TP2, TP2/EP2 and TP4 variants with MTP depths 3, 5, 6 and 7 and HiCache. A new section 3.3 documents the pinned container, the `nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4` checkpoint (not NVFP4-V2), host-DRAM needs, and the excluded harness settings. The InferenceX lane is labelled `dynamo-sglang`, but its executed commands were plain `sglang.launch_server` behind `sglang_router`, so the page does not present it as Dynamo. Small `--max-running-requests` limits (1 to 8; 224 for TP2/EP2), FP8 KV cache, `--enable-linear-replayssm-spec` drift, the long watchdog and `--allow-auto-truncate` are called out as tradeoffs.

The rendered Mintlify selector was exercised across all five variants and both roles, including copy, on an earlier iteration of this branch that also carried the GB200 selector; after rebasing onto `main` only the Mintlify build validation, broken-link check, cookbook config check and codespell were re-run. [Run 34548026742, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34548026742), at InferenceX commit `6b7dcd07ab0c8c0805ac7fbec2f2ded38d450c20`, executed five agentic benchmarks and four GSM8K evals; strict exact match was 0.9735 to 0.9788 (n=1319). The TP4/c4 variant had no eval. That is existing harness qualification. The generated standalone Docker, worker and router commands have **not** been independently executed on B300.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

Qwen3.5 选择器此前没有 B300 NVFP4 Agentic 部署入口，其 HiCache、MTP 和调度设置也没有文档。本 PR 在现有选择器中加入 **Agentic 聚合 + router（B300 NVFP4）**，覆盖 [InferenceX #2978](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2978) 已验证的五种服务配置。

选择器为 TP2、TP2/EP2、TP4（MTP 步数 3/5/6/7，含 HiCache）生成可复制的 worker（`sglang serve`）与 router 命令。新增 3.3 节说明固定镜像、`nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4` checkpoint（非 NVFP4-V2）、HiCache 主机内存需求以及已排除的测试框架设置。InferenceX 中该配置标记为 `dynamo-sglang`，但实际执行的是 `sglang.launch_server` 加 `sglang_router`，因此页面不将其描述为 Dynamo。较小的 `--max-running-requests`（1 到 8；TP2/EP2 为 224）、FP8 KV cache、`--enable-linear-replayssm-spec` 漂移、较长 watchdog 以及 `--allow-auto-truncate` 均作为取舍明确说明。

已在本分支较早的版本（同时包含 GB200 选择器）的渲染 Mintlify 页面中验证五种配置和两种命令角色，包括复制；重新基于 `main` 后仅重新运行了 Mintlify 构建校验、断链检查、cookbook 配置检查和 codespell。[Run 34548026742, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34548026742) 对应 InferenceX 提交 `6b7dcd07ab0c8c0805ac7fbec2f2ded38d450c20`，执行了五个 agentic 基准任务和四个 GSM8K 评测，严格精确匹配率 0.9735 至 0.9788（n=1319）；TP4/c4 配置没有评测。该证据来自原有测试框架；生成的独立 Docker、worker 和 router 命令尚未在 B300 上单独执行。

</details>

nodes.body:
Hi @faradawn, thank you for all your help with the Qwen3.5 cookbook. Whenever you have a moment, could you please review this PR? It adds an "Agentic aggregated + router (B300 NVFP4)" option to the Qwen3.5 selector, covering the five variants qualified in InferenceX #2978 (TP2, TP2/EP2 and TP4, with MTP and HiCache), and a new section 3.3 describing them.

It is a standalone change on top of `main`. I'd especially appreciate your eyes on the selector wiring, the excluded benchmark-only settings, and the tradeoff notes. InferenceX #2978 can only merge once this lands, so any feedback is very welcome. Thanks again!
do we need all disagg configs? I thought only one is fine - to add server major flags. Approving to unblock.

Model Introduction @@ -119,7 +120,7 @@ This section provides deployment configurations optimized for different hardware **Interactive Command Generator**: Use the configuration selector below to automatically generate the appropriate deployment command for your hardware platform and capabilities. - + ### 3.2 Configuration Tips @@ -232,6 +233,159 @@ This section provides deployment configurations optimized for different hardware - **Xeon CPU service configuration**: Please refer to the `Notes` part in the serving engine launching section in [the SGLang CPU server document](../../../docs/hardware-platforms/cpu_server#launch-of-the-serving-engine) to better understand how to configure the arguments, especially for TP (tensor parallel) and NUMA binding settings. +### 3.3 B300 NVFP4 agentic aggregated serving with HiCache and MTP + +Use these recipes to serve long-context agentic coding traffic with +[`nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4`](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4) +on one 8-GPU B300 node. Each variant runs one aggregated SGLang worker (TP2, TP2 with EP2, +or TP4) with MTP speculative decoding through the checkpoint's NEXTN head and a HiCache +host-DRAM tier, behind the SGLang router. Prefill and decode are not disaggregated, and the +commands use `sglang serve` and `sglang_router.launch_router`, not `dynamo.sglang` or +`dynamo.frontend`. + +The settings below come from five executed variants in +[InferenceX PR #2978](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2978), at commit +`6b7dcd07ab0c8c0805ac7fbec2f2ded38d450c20`. The InferenceX lane carries a `dynamo-sglang` +label, but its executed worker command was `python3 -m sglang.launch_server` and its front +door was `python -m sglang_router.launch_router`. +[Run 34548026742, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34548026742) +executed five agentic benchmarks and four GSM8K evaluations (every variant except +`tp4-mtp6-c4`); strict exact match was 0.9735 to 0.9788 on 1319 samples. The harness +executed these serving settings; the standalone Docker, worker, and router commands below +have not been independently executed on B300. Select **Agentic aggregated + router (B300 +NVFP4)** in the deployment selector above to generate the worker and router commands for +any of the five variants. + + +These variants trade capacity for latency. `--max-running-requests` is 1 to 8 on the four +variants without EP, so higher client concurrency queues behind a small running batch; the +TP2/EP2 variant allows 224. FP8 E4M3 KV cache can affect accuracy, so validate your workload before +adopting it. `--enable-linear-replayssm-spec` with a BF16 Mamba state can drift over long +sequences; the server logs this at startup. The long `--watchdog-timeout` delays detection of +an unhealthy worker. The TP2/EP2 variant adds `--allow-auto-truncate`, which silently +truncates prompts that exceed the context length. + + +#### Prerequisites and versions + +- One B300 node with eight GPUs. The executed fingerprint reported driver `580.159.03`, + CUDA `13.0`, and Python `3.12.3`. TP2 variants use two GPUs and the TP4 variant uses four. +- Container: `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260901-07c8f729`. Preserve this tag; the + flags and environment variables below were validated on it. Its fingerprint reported + SGLang `0.0.0.dev1+g07c8f7294`. +- Checkpoint: the NVFP4 repository above, not the NVFP4-V2 repository used by the other + B200 and B300 aggregated commands. The executed revision was + `12b28061efd8145b11226e4fab2528ee4f39ef09`, loaded with `--quantization modelopt_fp4`. +- Free host DRAM for the HiCache pool: `--hicache-size 128` on the TP2 variants, `32` on the + TP4 variant, and `--hicache-ratio 1.8` on the TP2/EP2 variant. Check the free memory on the + node before launch. + +On the B300 host, choose writable directories, download the checkpoint, and start the +container. `hf` is the Hugging Face CLI; authenticate with it if your environment requires +credentials. + +```bash Stage the checkpoint and start the container +export MODEL_DIR=/srv/models/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4 +export CACHE_DIR=/var/tmp/qwen35-agentic-cache +mkdir -p "$MODEL_DIR" "$CACHE_DIR/deepgemm-cache" "$CACHE_DIR/flashinfer-cache" "$CACHE_DIR/sglang-cache" +hf download nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4 \ + --revision 12b28061efd8145b11226e4fab2528ee4f39ef09 \ + --local-dir "$MODEL_DIR" +docker run --rm -it --gpus all --network host --ipc host \ + --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 \ + --mount "type=bind,src=$MODEL_DIR,dst=/model,readonly" \ + --mount "type=bind,src=$CACHE_DIR,dst=/configs" \ + lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260901-07c8f729 bash +``` + +#### Choose a serving variant + +The `c` suffix identifies the client concurrency the variant was measured at; it is not a +server admission limit. The scheduler, microbatch, prefill, and CUDA graph limits move +together in each generated command, so change them as a set. + + + + + + + + + + +

+ +Choose a variant in the deployment selector above, then choose **Worker** or **Router**. +The TP4 variant sets `--disable-prefill-cuda-graph` and the TP2/EP2 variant sets +`SGLANG_TRTLLM_MHA_DECODE_SEQ_LEN_SPLITS=2` and `SGLANG_ENABLE_JIT_DEEPGEMM=false`; the +generated commands carry these differences. The generated commands use `/model` and +`/configs` inside the container above. + +The generated commands set `--hicache-io-backend kernel` together with +`--hicache-mem-layout page_first_direct`. On the tested image the server logged that the +kernel IO backend does not support that layout and switched to the direct IO backend, so +the effective backend was `direct`. HiCache extends the radix cache, so the commands do +not set `--disable-radix-cache`. + +The recipes do not pass `--reasoning-parser` or `--tool-call-parser`. The tested image +logged the `qwen3` reasoning parser and `qwen3_coder` tool-call parser as auto-detected from +the chat template. Add the flags explicitly, as in the aggregated commands above, if you +need parsed output on a different build. + +#### Launch the worker and router + +Run the generated worker command inside the container and wait for the server to log that +it is ready on port `6100`. Hi @faradawn, thank you for all your help with the Qwen3.5 cookbook. Whenever you have a moment, could you please review this PR? It adds an "Agentic aggregated + router (B300 NVFP4)" option to the Qwen3.5 selector, covering the five variants qualified in InferenceX #2978 (TP2, TP2/EP2 and TP4, with MTP and HiCache), and a new section 3.3 describing them.

It is a standalone change on top of `main`. I'd especially appreciate your eyes on the selector wiring, the excluded benchmark-only settings, and the tradeoff notes. InferenceX #2978 can only merge once this lands, so any feedback is very welcome. Thanks again!
